name: Amazon product price tracker to Google Sheets

parameters.content:
## Amazon product price tracker to Google Sheets
Track the Amazon price of any list of ASINs. Each run appends one row per product with the price, the previous price and the change, so the sheet is a price history you can chart or filter for drops.

**Setup (about 3 minutes)**
1. Credentials > New > *Header Auth*. Name it `Apify API token`. Header name `Authorization`, value `Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN` (token: Apify Console > Settings > Integrations).
2. Open the Google Sheets node(s), connect Google Sheets OAuth2, and replace `YOUR_SHEET_ID` (and the tab name if needed).
3. Edit the `asins` list and `marketplace` (US, UK, DE, CA) in *Run Apify actor*.
4. Click *Execute workflow* to test with the small sample input, then activate.

Runs the Apify actor https://apify.com/transparent_meteorite/amazon-product-search (pay-per-result; the free Apify plan credit covers a trial). Maintained by the author of the actor.
